@pytest.mark.parametrize("admission_intake", ["no_pre", "no_post"], indirect=True)
async def test_capture_historical_cardinality(admission_intake, request):
    import asyncpg
    import json
    from dataclasses import asdict
    from pathlib import Path

    f = admission_intake
    await test_t1_requires_one_selected_checker_in_each_phase(f)
    url = f.factory.kw["bind"].url.render_as_string(hide_password=False).replace("+asyncpg", "")
    connection = await asyncpg.connect(url)
    try:
        tables = {}
        for table in await connection.fetch("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename"):
            name = table["tablename"]
            quoted = '"' + name.replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = await connection.fetch(f"SELECT to_jsonb(r)::text AS value FROM public.{quoted} r ORDER BY to_jsonb(r)::text")
            if rows:
                tables[name] = [json.loads(row["value"]) for row in rows]
        snapshot = {
            "revision": "0081_operation_read_authority",
            "source_commit": "fac8ea5110dfe3ac1d8fa90a5f0ff132c3811034",
            "tables": tables,
            "seed": {
                "actor": f.actor.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "task": str(f.task), "assignment": str(f.assignment), "project": str(f.project),
                "namespace": asdict(f.namespace),
            },
        }
        label = request.node.callspec.params["admission_intake"]
        Path(f"/tmp/submission-history-{label}.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
    finally:
        await connection.close()
